resources.string: Drag back from the ball like a slingshot and let go to putt. The farther you drag, the harder you hit.
Prefer buttons? Use Aim left and right, the Power slider and Putt.
Sand slows the ball, water costs a stroke and puts the ball back, belts push it along and bumpers bounce it away.
Take turns. The fewest strokes over all the holes wins, and a hole ends at the stroke limit.
Miniature golf boomed in the United States around 1930, when thousands of courses opened, many of them on rooftops and empty lots.
